title: UpsertListing
description: A stock/security listing. Tickers are how price + volume + financial data is fetched downstream (LocalEdgarFetcher, OpenFIGI, exchange data feeds), so listings are first-class — a Company can have N listings and downstream loaders join by ticker. The listing is linked to its parent Company by company_gmr_id; sinks materialise the LISTED_AS edge from that.

exchange.description: Exchange code (e.g. 'US', 'NASDAQ', 'LSE', 'EURONEXT-PARIS'). 'US' is shorthand for the EDGAR universe; FIRDS-derived listings carry MIC codes.
